summary: Quick search dialog for commands and destinations, which can also be opened with Ctrl/⌘+K.
whenToUse: Feature-rich portals, for power users who rely on the keyboard.
whenNotToUse: As the only way to access a feature: every command must also exist in the interface.
Content search with complex remote results: use a search page.

props.name: commands
props.description: { id, label, section?, keywords?, description?, icon?, shortcut?, isDisabled? }.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Enables Ctrl/⌘+K (opt-in global listener, removed on unmount).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown when there are no results.

inherits: No direct HTML attributes: className is applied to the dialog.

keyboard.action: Highlight a command (focus stays in the field).
First clears the search, then closes and restores focus.

accessibility: Modal dialog with initial focus on the field, focus containment, and focus restoration.
Combobox with aria-activedescendant on the list (virtual focus).
Search is case- and accent-insensitive; keywords extend matching.
responsive: Limited maximum width; on mobile it takes up almost the whole viewport with a scrollable list.
commonMistakes: Enabling hotkey on multiple instances at the same time.

examples.name: RecentCommands
examples.title: Grouped commands with a Recent section
examples.description: Executed commands appear at the top in the Recent section; the shortcuts shown are visual hints only.

examples.name: ControlledStates
examples.title: Controlled open state, disabled items, and empty state
examples.description: Items are enabled based on the project state; emptyState customizes the no-results message.

limits: Local filtering of the provided commands: for async results, filter in the consumer and update commands.
